data.scope: Exploratory controlled forest roll, not a replacement for release/nightly or complete UI games. Sequential profiles have order/warmup bias; frame failures are data, not suppressed regression assertions.
data.baselineScope: Optional 1200ms requested blank and prepared-board RAF windows. Timers may run late; actual elapsed and gaps are recorded. Baseline sampling may warm up the browser and confound comparisons with runs without baselines; blank/idle/active comparisons do not establish causality.
